implementation.1: Capture labels, thumbnail Retry and floating progress are absent. Existing bounded provider recovery, Escape cancellation, evidence completeness and Send checks remain; reopening the comment and Done recovers failed or missing captures.
implementation.2: Collapsed comments use theme RGBA .84, 4px 8px padding and 7px radius. Their measured DOM geometry/style draw once in the Scene Canvas; transparent semantic buttons remain operable, with Canvas keyboard focus feedback. Summary text shrinks inside the surface content box.
implementation.3: Preview, formal and task inline references share neutral border/background/shadow. Formal text uses theme ink; task labels and titles display names without an added @. Reference occurrence component changes are owned by the reference executor.
implementation.5: Selected file actions retain removal and multi-file alignment. Global Mark, selection preview confirmation, @ search and native media playback remain available.
implementation.6: Hover and pointer lock share presentedMarkTarget over the displayed layer order, object opaque body, contentWorldBounds and audio rounded body. Letterbox and crossing/occluded rectangles form region annotations. Apply Mark selects the fixed target; Redraw re-enters Mark and temporarily clears editor hit areas. Leave, cancellation, pan, zoom and source updates clear or recompute guides.
implementation.7: Comment text, media and footer are separate layout regions. Actual visible screen measurements limit width and height during initial placement and every resize; region/group layout includes the real pin and gap. Media cards reserve editable text and complete media/footer areas.
implementation.8: Done uses the sibling capture-crop helper and same-presentation markerBounds/typed markTargets. It awaits up to two display frames for an actual matching target/pin, then copies pixels before draft/network/PNG work.

Independent review exposed CSS zoom width overflow, an open-editor resize without a parent React render, and long region text exceeding the translucent surface padding. These are covered by the final visible-size/summary fixes and actual geometry checks.

An earlier parallel full run returned a native HTML input character sequence mismatch. The same native input interaction code passed the focused serial run and the 27-item serial full run; no HTML input production changes were made.
One earlier alignment focus run reported Reconnecting while its existing focus assertion failed. The final selected four-test run passed with the production alignment logic preserved.
